::: {#exm-logical-entailment-arguments}
#### Entailment in the deployment arguments

In @exr-valid-arguments,
the premises of arguments 1, 3 and 4 logically entail their conclusions (@def-logical-entailment).
The premises of argument 2 do not:
the values $P$ false and $Q$ true make both premises true and the conclusion false.

:::
